responsibility: Implements the small build-time generator that derives GCC’s encoded GCOV_VERSION constant from the compiler version string and development phase. This standalone program parses the major/minor GCC version and release-state marker, applies the gcov version encoding rules documented in gcov-io.h, and emits a C preprocessor definition used by the gcov I/O subsystem so the compiler, gcov tools, and runtime agree on the on-disk gcno/gcda format version tag.
